dedupe_keys.name: arcgis gdb for cpbs report 23ucb01 a context sensitive street classification framework for speed limit setting

description: The Center for Pedestrian and Bicyclist Safety at UC Berkeley publishes geodatabases supporting report 23UCB01 on street classification for speed-limit setting. Zenodo supplies ArcGIS geodatabase files and an Excel data dictionary free under CC BY 4.0. The associated primary report explains a classification that combines movement function with surrounding place characteristics using national road and land-use inputs. These layers can define street contexts in transport-safety and traffic-behaviour simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived release. Coverage is the study street sample in the United States; the exact archived geographic extent requires checking inside the package. A limitation is that classification proposals are not legally adopted speed limits; national inputs may miss local design conditions. No archive was downloaded, classes audited or safety outcome verified.
